description: This file defines a Perl module for handling blacklist result sets, including methods to add values to the blacklist and check if a value is blacklisted, supporting different types such as cleartext, sha256_b64, and wildcard.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Component::ResultSet::Blacklist
classes.description: A Perl class representing a result set for blacklist entries, providing methods to add and verify blacklist values.

methods.name: _add_value
methods.description: Adds a value to the blacklist, supporting different types such as cleartext, sha256_b64, and wildcard.

methods.name: _is_value_ok
methods.description: Checks if a given value is not blacklisted based on existing entries, supporting cleartext, sha256_b64, and wildcard types.

methods.name: _blacklist_default_type
methods.description: Returns the default type used for blacklist entries, which is 'cleartext'.
